bio.text: Justin Boyd was elected to the Arkansas Senate in 2022 to represent District 27, which includes most of Fort Smith in Sebastian County.
He served in the Arkansas House from 2015 through 2022.
A native of Fort Smith, he is a pharmacist and co-owner of Coleman Pharmacy and Gibson's Pharmacy in Alma, with a Doctor of Pharmacy from UAMS and an MBA from the University of Arkansas.

sources.title: Biography of THE HONORABLE JUSTIN BOYD
